i.norm: Verifies that passing a {@code null} character array to {@link RandomStringGenerator.Builder#selectFrom(char...)} is accepted (it reverts to the default behavior of allowing any character) and that the builder's {@code DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_CODE_POINT} constant equals {@link Character#MAX_CODE_POINT} (1,114,111).
selectFrom(null) must not throw; it returns the same builder for chaining.
